atoms.text:
Today, Sonali is taking a trip to the doctor’s to get vaccinated.
Select the door to go in.

instruction.text: Choose the word parts in the right order to spell the adjective.

feedback.end: The helpful receptionist reassures Sonali that it will be okay.

instruction.text: Choose the right adjectives to fill in the gaps.

atoms.a: The doctor comes out and tells Sonali that the vaccine is really useful and very powerful.
atoms.b: The doctor comes out and tells Sonali that the vaccine is really ((++useful useless)) and very ((++powerful powerless)).

instruction.text: Then the doctor shows Sonali the vaccine. Which suffix do you need to describe the liquid in the syringe?

wrong.text: Is the liquid full of colour or without colour?

instruction.text: Choose the right adjectives to fill in the gaps.

atoms.a: The doctor is very careful and the injection is almost completely painless.
atoms.b: The doctor is very ((++careful careless)) and the injection is almost completely ((++painless painful)).

instruction.text: Which suffix do you need to describe Sonali’s mood?

wrong.text: Is she full of hope or without hope?

feedback.end: That’s right! Sonali is very hopeful about the future!
